columns.description: List of column attribute keys with optional arguments.

groupings.description: List of grouping attribute keys with optional arguments.

start_date.description: The start date of the time period of portfolio data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date of the time period of portfolio data in YYYY-MM-DD format.

portfolio_type.description: The type of portfolio (e.g., ENTITY, ENTITY_FUNDS, GROUP, GROUP_FUNDS, FIRM, FIRM_ACCOUNTS, FIRM_CLIENTS, FIRM_HOUSEHOLDS, FIRM_UNVERIFIED_ACCOUNTS).

portfolio_id.description: The ID of a portfolio configured in Addepar.

filters.description: A portfolio query filter may be attached to a portfolio query to filter rows from the result.

hide_previous_holdings.description: Set to true to exclude holdings not held at end of current period.

group_by_historical_values.description: Set to true to include previous values when grouping on a time varying attribute.

group_by_multiple_attribute_values.description: Set to true to breakout groupings by each value in an attribute with multiple values.

look_through_composite_securities.description: Set to true to look through components of composite securities (e.g., funds).

look_through_constituent_holdings.description: Set how many constituents are returned in the response by lookthrough type and threshold.

display_account_fees.description: Set to true to show account fees.

external_ids.description: The external ID of a portfolio configured in Addepar.
